definitions.short: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)
definitions.full: H5273. na 'iym I. נָעִים adjective pleasant, delightful (poetry); — absolute ׳נ Prov 22:18 +; construct נְעִים 2Sam 23:1 plural נְעִמִים Psa 16:6 , נְעִימִם 2Sam 1:23 , נְעִימִים Prov 23:8 ; feminine נְעִמוֺת Psa 16:11 ; — 1 delightful וְהַנּ ׳הַנֶּאֱהָבִים בְּחַיֵּיהֶם 2Sam 1:23 (of Saul and Jonath.); of wealth, וְנ יָקָר ׳הוֺן Prov 24:4 ; words 23:8 ; of acts, etc.: גַּםיָֿחַ֑ד אַחִים שֶׁבֶת וּמַהנּֿ ׳מַהטּֿוֺב Psa 133:1 ; singing praises to ׳י , 135:3 ; 147:1 ; keeping wise teachings Prov 22:18 ; as substantive = delight בַּנְּעִימִים וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּטּוֺב יְמֵיהֶם יְכַלּוּ Job 36:11 (of earthly prosperity); of spiritual delights Psa 16:6 ; 16:11 . 2 lovely, beautiful (physically), Song 1:16 (|| יָפֶה ). — Psa 81:3 ; 2Sam 23:1 see II. נָעִים below II. נעם . II. נָעִים adjective perhaps singing, sweetly sounding, musical ; — absolute נ ׳כִּנּוֺר Psa 81:3 sweetly-sounding lyre ; construct, as substantive, יִשׂ זְמִרוֺת ׳נְעִים 2Sam 23:1 Israel's sweet singer of songs (compare Dr 8:10 Löhr ; ᵑ9 egregius psaltes Israel , and so Ges Ew and others, from I. נעם ; joy of the songs of Israel HPS, compare Klo Kit). נעץ (√ of following; Late Hebrew נָעַץ prick, stick or thrust in, wedge in ; נְעַץ ᵑ7 id. ; Late Hebrew נַעֲצוּץ figurative of wicked person ; נַעֲצוּצָא ᵑ7 = Biblical Hebrew).
